description: Given a list of at most32 half-open integer intervals [start,end], validate exact two-element lists, integer endpoints excluding bool, -100<=start<end<=100. Return {intervals:[[start,end],...],covered:integer}. Sort and merge overlapping OR touching intervals; covered is union length. Empty input yields empty intervals and covered0. Implement summarize(value) in totals.py returning the exact report dictionary; report.py reads one JSON value from stdin, prints that report and exits 0, or exits 2 for invalid JSON/input. summarize must raise ValueError for invalid input. Update test_totals.py with discriminating unittest tests. Change all three files. Use only the Python standard library. Only the existing three flat files may change.
